project.name: Automation Runner Milestone 1 — Legacy JSON Execution Lane

phases.title: Canonical Runner Authority
acceptance: Freeze authority, projection, graph runtime, recovery, and operator-signal seams in the new runner without removing this legacy execution lane.
phases.instructions: Implement Milestone 1 Phase 1 from the governing runner spec. Keep the legacy JSON runner operational; do not cut over production execution to automation/runner.
phases.qa_focus: Reject placeholder topology, authority confusion, and changes that disable the legacy runner.

phases.title: Prompt Authority Library
acceptance: Separate prompt assets, assemblies, bindings, and runtime instantiations with registry-only admission.
phases.instructions: Implement Milestone 1 Phase 2 from the governing runner spec.
phases.qa_focus: Reject raw-path binding and collapsed prompt authority.

phases.title: Role Registry And Session Policy
acceptance: Keep implementer and reviewer roles distinct from model, session, and prompt policy.
phases.instructions: Implement Milestone 1 Phase 3 from the governing runner spec.
phases.qa_focus: Reject role proliferation and session policy hidden in prompts.

phases.title: Phase Programs And Prompt Bindings
acceptance: Lower declared phase programs and bind prompts through named policy rather than ad-hoc conditionals.
phases.instructions: Implement Milestone 1 Phase 4 from the governing runner spec.
phases.qa_focus: Reject branch-heavy execution policy and unvalidated program bindings.

phases.title: LangGraph Orchestration Graph
acceptance: Graph-owned execution, checkpoint continuity, and authority-event append paths are explicit and testable.
phases.instructions: Implement Milestone 1 Phase 5 from the governing runner spec.
phases.qa_focus: Reject checkpoint-as-authority confusion and imperative orchestration leakage.

phases.title: Recovery, Loop Reset, And Session Cutover
acceptance: Recovery, malformed outcome repair, stale-turn handling, and session reset preserve authoritative event history.
phases.instructions: Implement Milestone 1 Phase 6 from the governing runner spec.
phases.qa_focus: Reject blind reruns, stale outcome acceptance, and recovery paths that mutate authority incorrectly.

phases.title: Operator Signals And Notification Policy
acceptance: Operator intervention and notification policy are explicit, scoped, and non-authoritative unless recorded as events.
phases.instructions: Implement Milestone 1 Phase 7 from the governing runner spec.
phases.qa_focus: Reject notification as control authority and uncontrolled live injection.

phases.title: Consumer Configuration And Runner Generation
acceptance: Finish Milestone 1 with consumer configuration and generation boundaries while retaining the validated legacy lane until an explicit cutover gate passes.
phases.instructions: Implement Milestone 1 Phase 8 from the governing runner spec. Do not retire automation/legacy_phase_runner in this milestone.
phases.qa_focus: Reject a premature cutover, generated compatibility ballast, and source/projection confusion.
